responsibility: This definition module declares a simple source-scanning utility that reads one input stream and returns whitespace-delimited symbols with basic diagnostic support. It belongs to the gm2 lexical/parsing support layer and exports source open/close operations, GetNextSymbol token fetching, WriteError for file-and-line anchored error reporting, TerminateOnError to make diagnostics fatal, and DefineComments to configure comment delimiters recognized by the scanner.
same_name_distinction: Declaration half of the Scan pair: it defines the public scanner API—source open/close, token retrieval, error reporting, fatal-on-error mode, and comment configuration—without the state machine and input handling logic found in the implementation file.
